entities.summary: Melinda Marilyn Snodgrass is an American science fiction writer for print and television. In February 2021 Snodgrass was the Screenwriting Guest of Honor and Keynote Speaker at the 39th annual Life, the Universe, & Everything professional science fiction and fantasy arts symposium.
